description_target.target_text: Use the nonzero header colors as a depth palette. Then recolor the body so that depth 1 gets the first header color, depth 2 the second, and so on.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (cell< a b)
      (if (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))))
    (define (flat grid) (apply append grid))
    (define (drop-n xs n)
      (if (or (<= n 0) (empty? xs)) xs (drop-n (rest xs) (- n 1))))
    (define (drop-last xs)
      (if (or (empty? xs) (empty? (rest xs)))
          (list)
          (cons (first xs) (drop-last (rest xs)))))
    (define (keep-cell? v) (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 9))))
    (define (shape-mask grid)
      (grid-from-fn (rows grid) (cols grid)
        (lambda (r c) (if (keep-cell? (at grid r c)) 1 0))))
    (define (min-row cells) (apply min (map first cells)))
    (define (min-col cells) (apply min (map second cells)))
    (define (component< a b)
      (let ((ac (obj-cells a)) (bc (obj-cells b)))
        (if (= (min-col ac) (min-col bc))
            (< (min-row ac) (min-row bc))
            (< (min-col ac) (min-col bc)))))
    (define (component-masks grid)
      (let ((mask (shape-mask grid)))
        (map (lambda (obj)
               (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows grid) (cols grid) 0) (obj-cells obj) 1))
             (sort (objects mask 0) component<))))
    (define (mask-cells grid)
      (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 0)))
              (grid-positions grid)))
    (define (boundary-cell? p cur)
      (any? (lambda (d)
              (let ((rr (+ (first p) (first d))) (cc (+ (second p) (second d))))
                (or (not (in-bounds? rr cc (rows g) (cols g)))
                    (not (member? (list rr cc) cur)))))
            cardinal-deltas))
    (define (peel-component layers cur depth)
      (if (empty? cur)
          layers
          (let* ((boundary (filter (lambda (p) (boundary-cell? p cur)) cur))
                 (next-layers (paint-cells layers boundary depth))
                 (remaining (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? p boundary))) cur)))
            (peel-component next-layers remaining (+ depth 1)))))
    (define (onion-layers grid)
      (for/fold ([layers (empty-grid (rows grid) (cols grid) 0)])
                ([comp (in-list (component-masks grid))])
        (peel-component layers (mask-cells comp) 1)))
    (define (max-depth grid)
      (let ((layers (onion-layers grid)))
        (let ((vals (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0)) (flat layers))))
          (if (empty? vals) 0 (apply max vals)))))
    (define (count-depth layers d)
      (length (filter (lambda (v) (= v d)) (flat layers))))
    (define (depth-hist grid)
      (let* ((layers (onion-layers grid))
             (vals (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0)) (flat layers)))
             (md (if (empty? vals) 0 (apply max vals))))
        (map (lambda (d) (count-depth layers d)) (range 1 (+ md 1)))))
    (define (crop-nonzero grid)
      (let ((cells (filter (lambda (p) (keep-cell? (at grid (first p) (second p))))
                           (grid-positions grid))))
        (if (empty? cells)
            (list (list 0))
            (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
                   (r0 (first bb)) (c0 (second bb)) (r1 (third bb)) (c1 (fourth bb)))
              (subgrid grid r0 c0 r1 c1)))))
    (define (extract-panels grid)
      (let scan ([c 0] [start 0] [acc (list)])
        (cond [(= c (cols grid))
               (if (> c start)
                   (append acc (list (subgrid grid 0 start (- (rows grid) 1) (- c 1))))
                   acc)]
              [(all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r c) 9)) (range 0 (rows grid)))
               (scan (+ c 1) (+ c 1)
                     (if (> c start)
                         (append acc (list (subgrid grid 0 start (- (rows grid) 1) (- c 1))))
                         acc))]
              [else (scan (+ c 1) start acc)])))
    (define (majority-color values)
      (let ((vals (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) values)))
        (if (empty? vals)
            0
            (let* ((colors (remove-duplicates vals))
                   (scored (map (lambda (col)
                                  (list col (length (filter (lambda (v) (= v col)) vals))))
                                colors))
                   (sorted (sort scored
                                 (lambda (a b)
                                   (if (= (second a) (second b))
                                       (< (first a) (first b))
                                       (> (second a) (second b)))))))
              (first (first sorted))))))
    (define (component-color grid comp-mask)
      (majority-color
       (map (lambda (p) (at grid (first p) (second p))) (mask-cells comp-mask))))
    (define (palette-from-pair plain colored)
      (let* ((layers (onion-layers plain))
             (vals (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0)) (flat layers)))
             (md (if (empty? vals) 0 (apply max vals))))
        (map (lambda (d)
               (majority-color
                (map (lambda (p) (at colored (first p) (second p)))
                     (filter (lambda (p) (= (at layers (first p) (second p)) d))
                             (grid-positions layers)))))
             (range 1 (+ md 1)))))
    (define (palette-color palette depth)
      (if (empty? palette) 0 (list-ref palette (min (- depth 1) (- (length palette) 1)))))
    (define (apply-palette panel palette)
      (let ((layers (onion-layers panel)))
        (grid-from-fn (rows panel) (cols panel)
          (lambda (r c)
            (let ((d (at layers r c)))
              (if (= d 0) 0 (palette-color palette d)))))))
    (define (grow-one-layer grid)
      (let ((mask (shape-mask grid)))
        (for*/fold ([out mask])
                   ([r (in-range (rows mask))]
                    [c (in-range (cols mask))])
          (if (= (at mask r c) 0)
              out
              (for/fold ([acc out]) ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
                (let ((rr (+ r (first d))) (cc (+ c (second d))))
                  (if (in-bounds? rr cc (rows mask) (cols mask))
                      (set-cell acc rr cc 1)
                      acc)))))))
    (define (majority-grid panels)
      (let ((n (length panels)) (h (rows (first panels))) (w (cols (first panels))))
        (grid-from-fn h w
          (lambda (r c)
            (let ((hits (length (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at p r c) 0))) panels))))
              (if (>= (* hits 2) n) 1 0))))))
    (define (rotk grid k)
      (cond [(= (modulo k 4) 0) grid]
            [(= (modulo k 4) 1) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= (modulo k 4) 2) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [else (rotate-ccw grid)]))
    (define (pad-to grid h w)
      (for*/fold ([out (empty-grid h w 0)])
                 ([r (in-range (rows grid))]
                  [c (in-range (cols grid))])
        (set-cell out r c (at grid r c))))
    (define (normalized-depth-map grid)
      (crop-nonzero (onion-layers grid)))

    (let* ((palette (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (first g)))
           (body (subgrid g 1 0 (- (rows g) 1) (- (cols g) 1)))
           (layers (onion-layers body)))
      (for*/fold ([out g])
                 ([r (in-range (rows body))]
                  [c (in-range (cols body))])
        (let ((d (at layers r c)))
          (if (= d 0)
              out
              (set-cell out (+ r 1) c (palette-color palette d))))))
  ))
